author: Priya Natarajan
title: Add the CI test suite
body: Adds pytest and Jest suites to CI, 1,180 tests, running on every PR in about six minutes.

author: Marcus Chen
title: Automated rollback with reversible migrations
body: Every deploy now ships with a reversible migration and a one-command rollback. Rollback was exercised in production twice this week; no manual database restore is needed any more.

author: Priya Natarajan
title: Fix timezone bug in invoice dates
body: Invoices generated after 23:00 UTC showed the next day's date. Dates are now rendered in the customer's billing timezone.

author: Marcus Chen
title: Raise the API gateway body limit to 100 MB
body: Upgrades Envoy to 1.31 and raises the request body limit on the gateway from 10 MB to 100 MB. Load-tested with 95 MB payloads; p99 latency unchanged. The old 10 MB limit was a default we never revisited.

author: Sofia Rossi
title: New onboarding checklist component
body: Replaces the modal onboarding with an inline checklist. Completion rate in the A/B test went from 41% to 58%.

author: Marcus Chen
title: Bump Kubernetes to 1.31
body: Cluster upgrade with no API deprecations affecting our manifests.

author: Lena Fischer
title: Dedupe events by idempotency key
body: Pipeline now drops duplicate events within a 24-hour window.

author: Priya Natarajan
title: Rate-limit the export endpoint
body: Exports are limited to 10 per hour per tenant after the incident on May 9.

author: Sofia Rossi
title: Playwright end-to-end suite for checkout and onboarding
body: Adds 64 Playwright tests covering sign-in, onboarding, checkout and the billing portal. Runs against staging on every release candidate.

author: Jonah Mbeki
title: Add security headers
body: CSP, HSTS and frame-ancestors headers added to all responses.

author: Sofia Rossi
title: Dark mode
body: Adds a theme toggle and dark tokens.

author: Marcus Chen
title: Spot instances for batch workers
body: Batch workers run on spot capacity with checkpointing; saves about 60% on that pool.
